responsibility: This file implements mc’s buffered diagnostic system. It builds linked error and warning records tied to token numbers from mcLexBuf, formats messages with file/line/column and include-stack context, distinguishes warnings from fatal compilation errors, flushes pending diagnostics in GCC-like style, and provides the emergency internalError path used when the compiler itself breaks an invariant. It is the central reporting backend for both parser-generated and semantic diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation side of mcError: it defines the error record structure, buffering/chaining machinery, token-to-file/line/column formatting via mcLexBuf, include-context emission, and flush/abort behavior, while mcError.def only publishes that API.
